items.evidence: README command `leverage play .../work --seed 1 --ticks 600 --settings <scratch> --inputs 5:enter,6:shoot,100:up,150:none` printed one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts; --ticks 3 shows screen title.
README frame command (run from judge-scratch) wrote frame.png: `file` says PNG 800 x 480; title/settings/shop/play frames also 800x480 and show the view.
Fresh place, tick 3: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], saved false; 2:enter -> tick 3 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.

Settings: 4x right from 8 -> 9,10,10,10; 15x left -> down to 0 and held at 0. Language right: en->es->fr, stays fr; left back to en, stays en. Difficulty starts normal; right -> hard (stays), left -> normal -> easy (stays).

With fr and es kept, texts of title, settings, play, paused, shop, lost, won all translated (e.g. fr: Record : 0 / Commencer / Reglages / Quitter; En pause / Reprendre / Titre; Boutique ... Vague suivante; Gagne / Entree : titre; es: Mejor / Empezar / Tienda / Siguiente oleada / Ganaste / Perdiste). Only the game name stays English.
Run 1 in folder K set volume 3, difficulty easy, language fr (settings.json written); run 2 on K started with volume 3, fr, easy. Fresh folder starts volume 8, en, normal.
Up held ticks 100-150: guard_y 6 -> 11 (0.1/tick = 6/s); down 30 ticks: 6 -> 3. Held up 200 ticks stops at 12, held down stops at 0.
Held shoot: bolts appear at ticks 4, 28, 52 (24 apart), never more; bolt moves 0.2333/tick (14/s); bolt at 19.73 is gone two ticks later (past 20).
Seed 1 wave 1: walkers enter at x=20 at ticks 4, 94, 184, 274, 364 (90 ticks) in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5/s), health 2; exactly 5 then shop.
Walker in lane 6: bolt hits at tick 295 -> health 1 and the bolt is gone; second bolt at 317 -> walker gone, score 0->10, coins 0->1. Bolts at y=6 pass walkers at y=4 and 8 with health unchanged.
Wave 1 with 3 walkers unshot: gate 10 -> 7, score only from the 2 killed (20). Hard run: gate 2 reaches 0 in wave 2 -> screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Best: 0, Enter: title].
Difficulty easy then Start: gate_health 14 (Gate: 14); hard then Start: gate_health 7.

Seed 1 wave 1 ends -> screen shop, texts [Shop, Coins: 2, Next: wave 2, Quick hands: 0/2, price 5, Heavy bolts: 0/1, price 12, Mason: gate +3 health, price 4, Next wave]; state identical at ticks 1000-1400, no enemies/bolts.
start_coins=40: Enter on Quick hands 40->35 (quick 1), ->25 (quick 2), third Enter no change. In play, quick 1 fires at 1207,1225,1243,1261 (18 ticks); quick 2 fires at 9,21,33,45 (12 ticks).
Heavy bought 25->13 coins, second Enter no change; in wave 2 walkers in the guard's lane die to a single bolt (health never shows 1), +10 score each.
Gate 5 (normal, start 10): Mason 13->9 coins gate 8, then 9->5 gate 10 (capped, not 11), then Enter with gate 10 changes nothing. With 3 coins and gate 5, Enter on Mason changes nothing.
Next wave entered at tick 7 (play at 8): first walker at x=20 at tick 68 (60 later); 7 walkers spawned 90 ticks apart; HUD 'Wave 2 of 8' (Oleada 2 de 8 / Vague 2 sur 8 in es/fr).

Wave 3: 6 walkers 72 ticks apart (1.2 s), then runners at 2888, 2960 ... (72 apart) with health 1, x 13.0 -> 8.0 over 100 ticks (3/s); 10 enemies (9 through, 1 killed); killed runner gave +15 score, +1 coin.
Wave 4: 9th enemy at 4260 is a brute, health 6, x falls 1/60 per tick (1/s); full run: brute through the gate takes 3 (56 -> 53); wave 5 kill of runner+brute gave +55 points +4 coins (brute 40/3).
modules/work/waves.txt holds one line per wave (walkers runners brutes seconds) read by the rules; README 'Change a wave' says to edit that file.

Full 8-wave run (seed 1, start_gate=150 test hook so the gate survives, shoot held, Next wave at each shop) -> won; last play state score 135, gate 53 -> won score 1195 = 135 + 20*53; Enter -> title showing Best: 1,195.

Escape at 50 -> paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; state at tick 80 identical to unpaused tick 50 (enemies, bolts). Enter on Resume -> play continuing (tick 130 equals unpaused tick 99). Title -> title screen.
saved false during wave 1, true when shop opens; a later run on that folder shows texts [..., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].

Folder left in shop (wave 1, coins 5, gate 10, quick 2, heavy 1 after purchases): next run Continue -> shop with Coins: 5, quick 2/2, heavy 1/1, gate 10, wave 1; Next wave plays 'Wave 2 of 8' with 12-tick fire and one-bolt kills.

Start on a saved folder -> saved false, next run's title has no Continue. Hard run lost -> saved false, later title no Continue. Continue, Next wave, Escape, Title -> title with Continue, saved true; continuing it again gives the last shop (wave 1, coins 5).
Won with 1195 -> title 'Best: 1,195', and a new run on that folder shows Best: 1,195; then a lost run with score 0 -> lost screen shows Best: 1,195, best stays 1195. Won/lost screens show 'Best: N'.
Two copies of the same kept folder, seed 5, 700 ticks, same script: printed states byte-identical; seed 9 put walkers in other lanes; fresh seed 1 lanes 2,4,8,6,6 vs seed 2 lanes 4,8,4,2,8.

Wave 8 frame (start_wave=8 hook): green cubes = walkers, small gold spheres = runners, large red cube = brute, white bolts at guard's y=8, blue guard, brown gate at left; pixel positions match state x/y; HUD 'Score: 85 Coins: 7 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 148'.
Title frame (English and French) with Start/Commencer outlined, settings frame in French with Difficulte : Facile outlined, shop frame with Mason outlined (menu_index 2).
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, one per language, used via @keys in assets/ui/*.json; README 'Add a language' says to copy en.json to xx.json and translate.

README has How to play, the headless and frame commands (both ran as written; I pointed --settings at my scratch folder), where kept (settings.json in the --settings folder; verified), change a wave, add a language.

defects: Adding --at print points can change how a long run unfolds: same inputs, 12720 ticks, --at 6000 vs --at 5000,6000 gives wave-5 runners 0.2 units (4 ticks) apart at tick 6000, and with --at at every 100 ticks the Next-wave Enter after wave 3 was missed; plain runs and repeated identical commands are deterministic. Whether the cause is the game or the engine is unclear.
On lost/won and then the title, the report still lists the last run's enemies (state not cleared after a run ends).
Shop and title frames draw the first or last button (Start, Next wave) in the blue 'primary' style besides the focus outline, so two entries look highlighted.
Mason's shop line does not say how far it is bought (brief: each thing with its price and how far it is bought); it is unlimited, so this is minor.
README's headless command writes the kept folder into work/kept; the judge used a scratch folder instead.
